behaviour: Unit tests for the range model helpers and for mapping ranges onto wrapped lines.
rules: 1. Import the helpers from `../src/textStyleRanges`, `wrapText` from `../src/textWrapping`, and `import type { FontString, TextStyleRange } from "../src/types";`.
2. Use `const font = "10px Cascadia, Segoe UI Emoji" as FontString;` — in tests every character measures 10px, so a max width of N*10 fits N characters.

3. For wrapping cases, flatten `getTextStyleLineRuns(wrapText(originalText, font, width), originalText, ranges)` and compare the concatenated text of runs whose color/backgroundColor is set with the expected originally styled substrings; assert at widths 40, 60, 100 and Infinity in one `it.each`.

tests.name: insert before a range shifts it
tests.given: [{start:6,end:11,color:'#e03131'}], shiftRangesForEdit from 'hello world' to 'XXhello world'
tests.expect: [{start:8,end:13,color:'#e03131'}]

tests.name: insert at a range start shifts it, at its end leaves it
tests.given: [{start:2,end:4,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,2,0,1) and shiftRangesForSplice(r,4,0,1)
tests.expect: [{start:3,end:5,...}] and [{start:2,end:4,...}]

tests.name: insert inside a range grows it
tests.given: [{start:2,end:6,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,4,0,3)
tests.expect: [{start:2,end:9,color:'red'}]

tests.name: delete inside a range shrinks it
tests.given: [{start:2,end:8,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,3,2,0)
tests.expect: [{start:2,end:6,color:'red'}]

tests.name: delete across a boundary trims the range
tests.given: [{start:4,end:8,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,2,4,0) and shiftRangesForSplice(r,6,4,0)
tests.expect: [{start:2,end:4,...}] and [{start:4,end:6,...}]

tests.name: delete covering a range removes it
tests.given: [{start:4,end:6,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForSplice(r,3,5,0)

tests.name: edit after a range leaves it alone
tests.given: [{start:0,end:5,color:'red'}], shiftRangesForEdit from 'hello world' to 'hello worlds'
tests.expect: deep-equal [{start:0,end:5,color:'red'}]

tests.name: unchanged text or no ranges returns the same reference
tests.given: ranges array r; shiftRangesForEdit(r,'abc','abc'), shiftRangesForEdit([],'a','b'), shiftRangesForEdit(undefined,'a','b')
tests.expect: toBe r, toBe the same [] instance, undefined

tests.name: applyStyleToRange splits an existing range
tests.given: [{start:0,end:10,color:'red'}], applyStyleToRange(r,3,6,{backgroundColor:'#ffec99'})
tests.expect: [{0,3,color red},{3,6,color red,backgroundColor #ffec99},{6,10,color red}]

tests.name: applyStyleToRange fills gaps and merges equal neighbours
tests.given: [{start:0,end:2,color:'red'},{start:5,end:7,color:'red'}], applyStyleToRange(r,2,5,{color:'red'})
tests.expect: [{start:0,end:7,color:'red'}]

tests.name: applyStyleToRange clears a style with null
tests.given: [{start:0,end:4,color:'red',backgroundColor:'#ffec99'}], applyStyleToRange(r,0,4,{backgroundColor:null}) then {color:null}
tests.expect: [{start:0,end:4,color:'red'}] then []

tests.name: applyStyleToRange with an empty span changes nothing
tests.given: r, applyStyleToRange(r,3,3,{color:'blue'})
tests.expect: deep-equal normalizeRanges(r)

tests.name: normalizeRanges sorts, drops invalid and resolves overlaps
tests.given: [{start:5,end:9,color:'a'},{start:2,end:2,color:'b'},{start:0,end:6,color:'c'},{start:9,end:10}]
tests.expect: [{start:0,end:6,color:'c'},{start:6,end:9,color:'a'}]

tests.name: clampRanges clamps to the text length
tests.given: [{start:-3,end:4,color:'a'},{start:8,end:20,color:'b'},{start:12,end:15,color:'c'}], length 10
tests.expect: [{start:0,end:4,color:'a'},{start:8,end:10,color:'b'}]

tests.name: sanitizeTextStyleRanges drops corrupt entries
tests.given: input 'nope', null, and an array with: valid entry, start 1.5, start >= end, no style, color 42, color 'url(http://x)', color 'x'.repeat(65), end beyond length
tests.expect: [] for non-arrays; only the valid entry and the clamped out-of-range entry survive, as fresh objects without extra keys

tests.name: getTextStyleLineRuns returns null without ranges or on mismatch
tests.given: ranges [] / undefined; and text 'abc' with originalText 'xyz' and a range
tests.expect: null in all cases

tests.name: unwrapped multi-line text maps runs per line
tests.given: originalText 'ab\ncd', text identical, range {start:1,end:4,color:'red'}
tests.expect: [[{a,null},{b,red}],[{c,red},{d,null}]] (backgroundColor null everywhere); the \n is never part of a run

tests.name: wrapped runs cover exactly the styled characters
tests.given: originalText 'Bid request timeout 120ms and more   words here', ranges on '120ms' (color) and 'more   words' (backgroundColor), wrapped at several widths
tests.expect: styled run text concatenates to '120ms' for color and to the styled characters that remain visible for the highlight (trimmed soft-break whitespace is never drawn), at every width

tests.name: withoutStyleRanges drops the key only when present
tests.given: an object with styleRanges [{start:0,end:1,color:'red'}] and another without the key
tests.expect: first: a new object with every other key equal and `'styleRanges' in result` false, input untouched; second: toBe the same object

tests.name: hard line starting with whitespace stays aligned
tests.given: originalText 'alpha beta\n  gamma', range on 'gamma', wrapped at width 50 and Infinity
tests.expect: the run with color is exactly 'gamma' on the last line

behaviour: jsdom tests of styled ranges through the editor, actions, restore, SVG export, containers, font change, undo/redo, reconcile, paste-styles and duplication.
rules: 1. Imports: `Excalidraw` from `../index`; `API` from `./helpers/api`; `Keyboard`, `Pointer`, `UI` from `./helpers/ui`; `getTextEditor`, `updateTextEditor` from `./queries/dom`; `act`, `render`, `unmountComponent`, `fireEvent`, `screen` from `./test-utils`; `actionChangeStrokeColor`, `actionChangeTextHighlight`, `actionChangeFontFamily` from `../actions/actionProperties`; `actionCopyStyles`, `actionPasteStyles` from `../actions/actionStyles`; `restoreElements` via `import * as restore from "../data/restore"`; `reconcileElements` and type `RemoteExcalidrawElement` from `../data/reconcile`; `exportScene` from `../scene/export`; `getDefaultAppState` from `../appState`; `CaptureUpdateAction`, `getTextStyleLineRuns`, `newElementWith`, `newTextElement` from `@excalidraw/element`; `FONT_FAMILY`, `KEYS` from `@excalidraw/common`.
2. Call `unmountComponent()` at module level; in `beforeEach` render `<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />` and `API.setElements([])`; `const { h } = window;`.

3. Open an editor on a new text with `UI.clickTool("text")`, `mouse.clickAt(20, 30)`, `const editor = await getTextEditor()`, `updateTextEditor(editor, "hello world")`; select with `editor.setSelectionRange(6, 11)` then `fireEvent.select(editor)`; run actions inside `act(() => h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value))`.

4. Read the edited element as `h.elements.find(isTextElement)` (import `isTextElement` from `@excalidraw/element`; latest object), never a stale reference; create the pointer with `const mouse = new Pointer("mouse");`.

5. "No ranges" on a created or restored element is asserted as key absence, `expect(el).not.toHaveProperty("styleRanges")` — never `toEqual([])`, which would also pass for a stored empty array. No test uses snapshots (`toMatchSnapshot`/`toMatchInlineSnapshot`).

tests.name: stroke colour applies to the selected range only
tests.given: editor open on 'hello world', selection 6..11, actionChangeStrokeColor with {color:'#e03131'}
tests.expect: text styleRanges equal [{start:6,end:11,color:'#e03131'}]; element strokeColor unchanged; h.state.currentItemStrokeColor unchanged

tests.name: highlight sets and clears backgroundColor on the range
tests.given: same editor and selection, actionChangeTextHighlight with {color:'#ffec99'}, then with {color:'transparent'}
tests.expect: [{start:6,end:11,backgroundColor:'#ffec99'}] then the element has no styleRanges key (the cleared highlight was its only style)

tests.name: highlight picker shows only with a selection
tests.given: editor open; selection 6..11 then collapsed to 3..3, each followed by fireEvent.select(editor)
tests.expect: screen.queryByTestId('text-highlight-#ffec99') present with the selection, null when collapsed and after the editor is closed

tests.name: typing before a styled range shifts it and submit keeps it
tests.given: range 6..11 coloured, then updateTextEditor(editor, 'XXhello world'), then Keyboard.exitTextEditor(editor)
tests.expect: styleRanges [{start:8,end:13,color:'#e03131'}] after the change and after submit

tests.name: no selection keeps element-wide stroke colour
tests.given: editor open with selection collapsed (3..3), actionChangeStrokeColor {color:'#e03131'}
tests.expect: element strokeColor is '#e03131' and the element has no styleRanges key

tests.name: new and restored legacy text have no styleRanges key
tests.given: API.createElement({type:'text'}); a newTextElement with styleRanges [] and one with only out-of-text ranges; and a text element object without styleRanges passed through restore.restoreElements([...], null)
tests.expect: not.toHaveProperty('styleRanges') on all of them

tests.name: deleting every styled character removes the key
tests.given: range 6..11 coloured, then updateTextEditor(editor, 'hello ')
tests.expect: the element has no styleRanges key

tests.name: restore sanitises corrupt ranges
tests.given: text 'hello' restored with styleRanges 'bad', with [], with only invalid entries, and with [{start:0,end:2,color:'red'},{start:3,end:99,backgroundColor:'#ffec99'},{start:'1',end:2,color:'red'},{start:1,end:2,color:7}]
tests.expect: no styleRanges key for 'bad', [] and the all-invalid list; [{start:0,end:2,color:'red'},{start:3,end:5,backgroundColor:'#ffec99'}] for the mixed array

tests.name: svg export writes tspans and highlight rects
tests.given: text 'hello world' with styleRanges [{start:6,end:11,color:'#e03131',backgroundColor:'#ffec99'}], exported with exportScene({type:'svg', data:{elements:[text], appState:{viewBackgroundColor:'#ffffff'}, files:{}}, config:{canvasBackgroundColor:false}})
tests.expect: one <text> with two <tspan>s: 'hello ' with fill = element strokeColor and 'world' with fill '#e03131'; one <rect> with fill '#ffec99' and positive width, placed before the <text>

tests.name: unstyled text exports as before
tests.given: the same text without a styleRanges key exported the same way
tests.expect: no <tspan> and no highlight <rect> inside the text group; <text> textContent 'hello world'

tests.name: ranges survive a bound container's wrapping
tests.given: rectangle 90x75, Enter to edit its label, type 'Bid request timeout 120ms', select 20..25, stroke colour '#e03131', exit editor
tests.expect: label text contains '\n'; styleRanges [{start:20,end:25,color:'#e03131'}]; styled runs of getTextStyleLineRuns(text, originalText, styleRanges) concatenate to '120ms'

tests.name: ranges survive a font family change
tests.given: styled text selected, actionChangeFontFamily with {currentItemFontFamily: FONT_FAMILY.Nunito}
tests.expect: fontFamily changed and styleRanges deep-equal to before

tests.name: undo and redo restore ranges
tests.given: text added with API.updateScene captureUpdate NEVER, then API.updateScene with newElementWith(text,{styleRanges:[{start:0,end:5,color:'#e03131'}]}) captureUpdate IMMEDIATELY
tests.expect: Keyboard.undo() gives styleRanges undefined (toBeUndefined); Keyboard.redo() gives [{start:0,end:5,color:'#e03131'}]

tests.name: reconcile keeps the winning element's ranges intact
tests.given: local text version 3 with ranges A, remote copy version 4 with ranges B (and a second pair where local has the higher version)
tests.expect: reconcileElements returns the remote element with exactly B in the first case and the local with exactly A in the second; no mixing

tests.name: paste styles does not copy ranges onto another text
tests.given: styled text A (ranges set) copied with actionCopyStyles, plain text B selected, actionPasteStyles
tests.expect: B still has no styleRanges key while its strokeColor matches A

tests.name: duplicate carries ranges
tests.given: styled text selected, Ctrl+D (Keyboard.withModifierKeys({ctrl:true}, () => Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.D)))
tests.expect: the duplicate has styleRanges deep-equal to the original's
